# cycle_available_integrations (Data Source)

Lists integration vendors the current hub can enable, flattened from the categorized `GET /v1/integrations/available` response.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# List vendors the hub can enable, flattened across catalog categories.
data "cycle_available_integrations" "all" {}

output "usable_vendors" {
  value = [
    for i in data.cycle_available_integrations.all.integrations : i.vendor
    if i.usable && !i.deprecated
  ]
}

output "infrastructure_providers" {
  value = [
    for i in data.cycle_available_integrations.all.integrations : i.vendor
    if i.category == "infrastructure-provider"
  ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `integrations` (Attributes List) Available integration definitions across all categories. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--integrations))

<a id="nestedatt--integrations"></a>
### Nested Schema for `integrations`

Read-Only:

- `category` (String) The catalog category: `billing`, `image-builders`, `infrastructure-provider`, `object-storage`, or `tls-certificate-generation`.
- `deprecated` (Boolean) Whether this integration is deprecated. `false` when the API omits the field.
- `editable` (Boolean) Whether an existing instance of this integration can be edited.
- `extends` (List of String) Functionality this integration extends (e.g. `backups`). Empty when omitted.
- `features` (List of String) Additional features supported by this integration. Empty when omitted.
- `name` (String) The human-readable name of the integration.
- `public` (Boolean) Whether this integration is publicly available.
- `supports_multiple` (Boolean) Whether the hub can create more than one instance of this integration.
- `supports_verification` (Boolean) Whether this integration supports a verification job after create.
- `url` (String) A URL with more information about the integration.
- `usable` (Boolean) Whether this integration can be used at this time.
- `vendor` (String) The vendor identifier used when creating a `cycle_integration`.
